Note: We moved Luna's litter tray from the spare room to the laundry room and changed to scented litter on the same day.
Note: We took Luna to the vet about the two accidents. The vet asked us to restore her previous litter arrangement and monitor her. I have not entered any test results or diagnosis into Furvise.
Note: Luna urinated on the bath mat once yesterday and once today. I have not noticed straining or repeated trips to the tray. I do not know whether the tray changes are connected.
Note: We moved Luna's tray back to the spare room and returned to unscented litter. We changed both things together.

sentences.text: On July 5, Luna’s tray was recorded in the laundry room and the litter was scented.
On July 10, her tray was recorded back in the spare room and the litter was unscented.
